intent: A monochrome answer card that streams a cited answer in uneven chunks that settle like ink, reads its sources first, then lists them, with Stop / Regenerate / Copy.

stack.fonts: font-sans (Geist, semibold) for the question, font-sans (Geist) for the answer, font-mono (Geist Mono) for status and labels

layout.root: @container article; the demo centres it on a black stage, max-w 820px
layout.card: surface #0e0e10, radius 24px, 1px #232327 border, inset top highlight white/5%, shadow 0 32px 80px -32px black/90%; three bands split by 1px rules: header, answer, footer
layout.header: mono 'Asked by' line led by a 20px hairline that draws in, then the semibold question
layout.answer: 24px status row, body with min-height 12rem (the reading list, then the answer), then sources
layout.sources: ol between #1b1b1e hairlines; rows are grid [2rem number | title + publisher | arrow], min 48px tall
layout.footer: mono disclaimer left; Stop/Regenerate and Copy right; wraps in narrow containers

color.palette: PALETTE.dark / PALETTE.light tokens written to --st-* CSS variables; theme prop picks one
color.dark: surface #0e0e10, line #232327, rule #1b1b1e, ink #f4f4f5, body #c6c6cc, muted #a1a1aa, faint #8a8a93, pill #202024
color.light: surface #ffffff, line #e4e4e7, rule #efeff1, ink #18181b, body #3f3f46, muted #52525b, faint #71717a, pill #f0f0f2
color.accent: one prop, default #ff9a6b, used only for the citation being pointed at and its linked source number (solid fill, contrast-picked ink). Everything else is greyscale: citation pills rest on the pill grey, the caret and live dot are ink, focus rings are ink.

motion.tokens: EASE_OUT [0.22,1,0.36,1], SPRING_UI 500/40, MOTION object holds every duration
motion.entrance: once 20% in view: card rises 12px out of an 8px blur (500ms), then asked-by (60ms, its hairline draws scaleX 0→1), question (120ms), status row (180ms), the reading list rows (260ms + 50ms each), footer (400ms)
motion.reading: after a 350ms lead, 900ms × pace of 'Reading 5 sources' with the five publishers listed in mono; they leave upward with a 4px blur when writing starts. No skeleton bars.
motion.tokenising: word tokens with whitespace; citations and bold runs atomic
motion.pacing: 1–3 tokens per tick; 14–48ms between words, 50–120ms after , ; —, 110–270ms after sentences, 260–480ms between paragraphs, 4% chance of a 180–380ms hesitation; `pace` multiplies all delays; one timer at a time, cleared on unmount
motion.ink: every emitted token (and citation) settles from opacity 0 and a 4px blur over 420ms, no movement, via one namespaced CSS keyframe (st-ink) — hundreds of one-shot fades are cheaper in CSS than a motion node each
motion.status: live word count ticks with tabular numerals ('Writing · 42 words'), then '156 words in 6.2s'
motion.sources: when done: heading then rows rise from blur, 50ms apart
motion.linking: hovering or focusing a citation highlights its source and vice versa, in the accent
motion.reducedMotion: full answer and sources render immediately; entrances are 150ms fades; no ink settle, caret or ping
motion.controls: buttons press 0.96; regenerate arrow rotates −180° on hover; copy icon pops to a check on spring.ui; source rows press 0.99

responsive.narrow: card padding 24px, answer 16.5px, footer wraps, 44px buttons
responsive.@xl (576px container): card padding 48px, answer 17.5px, 40px buttons, source titles truncate

accessibility: answer region aria-live=polite with aria-busy while reading/streaming
citations are links to the source anchors with aria-label 'Source n: title'
sources are an ordered list under an h3
text-labelled buttons with 2px ink focus rings; Copy disabled while streaming; a polite live region says 'Answer copied'
reduced motion renders the finished answer
source anchors use useId so two cards never collide

content.question: Why does my sourdough collapse when it goes in the oven?
content.answer: four paragraphs on overproofing, the poke test, hydration and preheating, with five citations

avoid: coloured citation pills at rest, accent carets or accent rules
